seasons.label: Archery
seasons.bag_limit_summary: 12 per season statewide; max 10 antlerless, max 2 antlered (antler restrictions apply).
seasons.notes: Either sex. Buck-only first two weeks in some SW counties. Extended archery in ~30 named counties through Jan 31.

seasons.label: Primitive Weapons
seasons.bag_limit_summary: Counts toward the 12-per-season statewide deer limit.
seasons.notes: 'Primitive Weapons & Youth Only Firearms' week, either sex.

seasons.label: Firearms
seasons.bag_limit_summary: Counts toward the 12-per-season statewide deer limit.
seasons.notes: Buck-only statewide; either-sex dates vary by county. Extended firearms in 9 SW counties through Jan 15. Firearms deer prohibited in parts of metro Atlanta and Jekyll Island.

seasons.label: Archery
seasons.bag_limit_summary: 2 per season; no more than 1 from the central or southern bear zones.

seasons.label: Primitive Weapons
seasons.bag_limit_summary: 2 per season; no more than 1 from the central or southern bear zones.

seasons.label: Firearms
seasons.bag_limit_summary: 2 per season; no more than 1 from the central or southern bear zones.

seasons.label: Firearms (single day)
seasons.bag_limit_summary: 2 per season; no more than 1 from the central or southern bear zones.
seasons.notes: Single-day firearms season (Dec 20). PDF notes a possible second day — confirm with DNR.

seasons.label: Firearms (segments)
seasons.bag_limit_summary: 2 per season; no more than 1 from the central or southern bear zones.
seasons.notes: NOT continuous — four 3-day segments: Sep 18-20, Sep 25-27, Oct 2-4, Oct 9-11. Span shown covers first and last segments only.

seasons.label: Split 1
seasons.bag_limit_summary: 6 ducks/day, 18 in possession; species sublimits apply (2 mallards/1 hen, 1 pintail, 3 wood ducks, 1 scaup, 2 canvasback, 2 redheads).
seasons.notes: First of two duck splits (Atlantic Flyway). Youth/military days Nov 15-16.

seasons.label: Split 2
seasons.bag_limit_summary: 6 ducks/day, 18 in possession; species sublimits apply (same as split 1).
seasons.notes: Second of two duck splits. Early teal Sep 13-21.

regs_note: Dates are 2025-26 license year from official Georgia DNR PDFs (2026-27 published only as Publuu flip-books, not machine-verifiable — TODO: seed 2026-27 from those). Deer either-sex firearms dates vary by county; several counties have extended archery/firearms seasons. Bear seasons differ substantially by zone (Central = single day; Southern = four discontinuous 3-day segments). No elk season in Georgia.
